pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} waking up in their favourite spot, stretching, ready for a big day of very important jobs.
pages.textTemplate:
Every morning, right on cue,
{{SUBJECT_NAME}} wakes with jobs to do.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} surveying the house or garden importantly, like a tiny supervisor.
pages.textTemplate:
A patrol of the house, a sniff of the air,
Making sure everything's properly there.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} pausing at the door or window, ears up, sensing something's about to happen.
pages.textTemplate:
But today was no ordinary patrol at all —
Because something rather important was about to befall.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} trotting off purposefully down the hall or garden path.
pages.textTemplate:
Off they trotted, official and proud,
On business too important to say out loud.

pages.sceneDescription: Family members greeting {{SUBJECT_NAME}} fondly as they pass by on patrol.
pages.textTemplate:
Everyone knew the patrol routine —
The most important pet they'd ever seen.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} pausing, head tilted, hearing or spotting something suspicious.
pages.textTemplate:
Then a sound! A shape! A rustling thing!
{{SUBJECT_NAME}}'s ears went straight up, alert to everything.

pages.sceneDescription: A signature quirky pet moment in full swing.
pages.textTemplate:
Because nobody does 'important business' quite like {{SUBJECT_NAME}} does —
And that's exactly why this story deserves applause.

pages.sceneDescription: The aftermath — mild happy chaos, tail wagging, pure joy.
pages.textTemplate:
It wasn't tidy, it wasn't neat,
But it was {{SUBJECT_NAME}}'s finest feat.

pages.sceneDescription: The family laughing, delighted, gathering round {{SUBJECT_NAME}}.
pages.textTemplate:
'That's so them!' the family cried,
With so much love, and so much pride.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} facing a small mystery — an object out of place, a closed door.
pages.textTemplate:
Then — a mystery! Right there in the hall!
Something that needed inspecting, that's all.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} investigating determinedly, pawing or sniffing at the mystery.
pages.textTemplate:
With a sniff and a paw and a very serious stare,
{{SUBJECT_NAME}} cracked the case, right then and there.

pages.sceneDescription: A second, distinct signature quirky pet moment.
pages.textTemplate:
Case closed — but the day wasn't nearly through,
There was still one more {{SUBJECT_NAME}}-thing left to do.

pages.sceneDescription: The ripple effect — toys scattered, a happy mess, everyone amused.
pages.textTemplate:
It turned the afternoon upside down,
In the very best way a pet's ever found.

pages.sceneDescription: A quiet nap moment — {{SUBJECT_NAME}} curled up in a sunbeam or favourite spot.
pages.textTemplate:
Even very important pets need rest,
So {{SUBJECT_NAME}} curled up — patrol paused, at best.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} waking up and heading out to a bigger space, refreshed.
pages.textTemplate:
But naps don't last — there's too much to see! —
So off {{SUBJECT_NAME}} went, business-bound and free.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} exploring a bigger outdoor scene — garden, park, or field.
pages.textTemplate:
Further out, past the fence, past the tree,
To see how big a patrol could really be.

pages.sceneDescription: A third signature quirky pet moment, in the bigger outdoor setting.
pages.textTemplate:
And no patrol of {{SUBJECT_NAME}}'s would ever be complete,
Without one final, unmistakably-them feat.

pages.sceneDescription: A triumphant, joyful moment — {{SUBJECT_NAME}} mid-zoomies or a victorious pose.
pages.textTemplate:
It was silly, it was brave, it was entirely their own —
A {{SUBJECT_NAME}}-sized moment for the whole world to be shown.

pages.sceneDescription: Golden hour, family gathering in the garden, {{SUBJECT_NAME}} the centre of attention.
pages.textTemplate:
As the sun dipped low and the sky turned gold,
The best part of the patrol was about to unfold.

pages.sceneDescription: The emotional high point — a warm, specific real moment between {{SUBJECT_NAME}} and their person.
pages.textTemplate:
Because the very best pet stories aren't the loud, big kind —
They're the small true moments that stick in your mind.

pages.sceneDescription: Everyone cheering and laughing, celebrating {{SUBJECT_NAME}}.
pages.textTemplate:
Everyone cheered — the whole house, it seemed! —
For a patrol that went better than anyone dreamed.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} heading back inside as evening falls.
pages.textTemplate:
And as the stars blinked on, one by one by one,
{{SUBJECT_NAME}} headed in — the patrol was done.

pages.sceneDescription: {{SUBJECT_NAME}} curling up in their bed or basket, sleepy and content.
pages.textTemplate:
Bed all fluffed and paws tucked tight,
{{SUBJECT_NAME}} settled in for the night.

pages.sceneDescription: Final goodnight image — {{SUBJECT_NAME}} fast asleep, moonlight through the window.
pages.textTemplate:
Because there's only one {{SUBJECT_NAME}} in the whole wide world,
And every quirk and story is a flag they've unfurled.
Goodnight, {{SUBJECT_NAME}} — patrol complete,
Tomorrow brings more business, important and sweet.
